name: Shadow’s Refuge
body:
Prerequisite(s): Shadow level 3rd, Stealth 3 ranks, Survival 3 ranks

Benefit(s): Once per day, you can use Stealth to create a hiding spot for yourself as a full- round action, even in areas with no cover or concealment. You gain a +5 circumstance bonus on your Stealth check to hide in this spot. The hiding spot lasts for 1 hour per Shadow level or until you leave it.

Other creatures can use your hiding spot, but they don’t gain the circumstance bonus.

Special: If you have the shadowcraft class feature, you can use it to enhance your hiding spot, increasing the circumstance bonus by your Charisma modifier.
